title: Osoyoos Half Day Wine Tour (Incl. Tasting Fees & Guide Gratuity!)
includes: Door to door pick up and drop off in Osoyoo and Oliver
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Get ready for a half-day wine adventure that's all about sipping and chilling! This tour whisks you away to 4 top-notch, award-winning vineyards on the dazzling Osoyoos/Oliver wine trail. With hassle-free pick-up and drop-off at your Osoyoos or Oliver digs, plus all tasting fees and a 15% tip for your fantastic guide covered, you can just sit back, relax, and soak up the fun with Sip Happens! Nestled at the southern tip of the Okanagan Valley, Osoyoos is Canada's sun-soaked red wine haven, where even the other regions come for grapes. Discover why this is red wine country on one of our unforgettable Osoyoos Wine Tours. We’ve got your pick-up, drop-off, concierge services, bottled water, and comfy, air-conditioned rides all sorted!
